name: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres, Auth, REST, Storage and Studio.

inputs.label: JWT secret
inputs.help: Signs every API token. Auto-generated if left blank.

inputs.label: Anon API key
inputs.help: Public client key, derived from the JWT secret. Leave blank.

inputs.label: Service role key
inputs.help: Full-access server key, derived from the JWT secret. Leave blank.

inputs.label: Dashboard username
inputs.help: Username for the Studio dashboard login.

inputs.label: Dashboard password
inputs.help: Password for the Studio dashboard login. Auto-generated if left blank.

compose:
name: "slashnode-supabase"
services:
  supabase-db:
    image: "supabase/postgres:15.1.0.147"
    container_name: "supabase-db"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    volumes:
      - "supabase-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_HOST: "/var/run/postgresql"
      POSTGRES_DB: "postgres"
      POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
      JWT_SECRET: "${secret.JWT_SECRET}"
      JWT_EXP: "3600"
  supabase-meta:
    image: "supabase/postgres-meta:v0.80.0"
    container_name: "supabase-meta"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    environment:
      PG_META_PORT: "8080"
      PG_META_DB_HOST: "supabase-db"
      PG_META_DB_PORT: "5432"
      PG_META_DB_NAME: "postgres"
      PG_META_DB_USER: "supabase_admin"
      PG_META_DB_PASSWORD: "${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
  supabase-auth:
    image: "supabase/gotrue:v2.151.0"
    container_name: "supabase-auth"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    environment:
      GOTRUE_API_HOST: "0.0.0.0"
      GOTRUE_API_PORT: "9999"
      API_EXTERNAL_URL: "${self.exports.url}"
      GOTRUE_DB_DRIVER: "postgres"
      GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL: "postgres://supabase_auth_admin:${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@supabase-db:5432/postgres"
      GOTRUE_SITE_URL: "${self.exports.url}"
      GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET: "${secret.JWT_SECRET}"
      GOTRUE_JWT_EXP: "3600"
      GOTRUE_JWT_AUD: "authenticated"
      GOTRUE_JWT_DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME: "authenticated"
      GOTRUE_JWT_ADMIN_ROLES: "service_role"
      GOTRUE_DISABLE_SIGNUP: "false"
      GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM: "true"
  supabase-rest:
    image: "postgrest/postgrest:v12.2.0"
    container_name: "supabase-rest"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    environment:
      PGRST_DB_URI: "postgres://authenticator:${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@supabase-db:5432/postgres"
      PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS: "public,storage,graphql_public"
      PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE: "anon"
      PGRST_JWT_SECRET: "${secret.JWT_SECRET}"
      PGRST_DB_USE_LEGACY_GUCS: "false"
  supabase-storage:
    image: "supabase/storage-api:v1.11.0"
    container_name: "supabase-storage"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    volumes:
      - "supabase-storage:/var/lib/storage"
    environment:
      ANON_KEY: "${secret.ANON_KEY}"
      SERVICE_KEY: "${secret.SERVICE_KEY}"
      POSTGREST_URL: "http://supabase-rest:3000"
      PGRST_JWT_SECRET: "${secret.JWT_SECRET}"
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://supabase_storage_admin:${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@supabase-db:5432/postgres"
      FILE_SIZE_LIMIT: "52428800"
      STORAGE_BACKEND: "file"
      FILE_STORAGE_BACKEND_PATH: "/var/lib/storage"
      TENANT_ID: "stub"
      REGION: "stub"
      GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET: "stub"
      IMGPROXY_URL: "http://supabase-imgproxy:5001"
  supabase-imgproxy:
    image: "darthsim/imgproxy:v3.8.0"
    container_name: "supabase-imgproxy"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    environment:
      IMGPROXY_BIND: ":5001"
      IMGPROXY_USE_ETAG: "true"
      IMGPROXY_ENABLE_WEBP_DETECTION: "true"
  supabase-studio:
    image: "supabase/studio:20240729-ce42139"
    container_name: "supabase-studio"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    environment:
      STUDIO_PG_META_URL: "http://supabase-meta:8080"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "${secret.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
      DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_NAME: "SlashNode"
      DEFAULT_PROJECT_NAME: "SlashNode"
      SUPABASE_URL: "http://supabase-kong:8000"
      SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL: "${self.exports.url}"
      SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: "${secret.ANON_KEY}"
      SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: "${secret.SERVICE_KEY}"
      AUTH_JWT_SECRET: "${secret.JWT_SECRET}"
  supabase-kong:
    image: "kong:2.8.1"
    container_name: "supabase-kong"
    restart: "unless-stopped"
    networks:
      - slashnode
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - "./config/kong.yml:/home/kong/kong.yml:ro"
    environment:
      KONG_DATABASE: "off"
      KONG_DECLARATIVE_CONFIG: "/home/kong/kong.yml"
      KONG_DNS_ORDER: "LAST,A,CNAME"
      KONG_PLUGINS: "request-transformer,cors,basic-auth"
networks:
  slashnode:
    external: true
volumes:
  supabase-db:
    name: "slashnode-supabase_supabase_supabase-db"
  supabase-storage:
    name: "slashnode-supabase_supabase_supabase-storage"

configs.content:
_format_version: "2.1"
consumers:
  - username: dashboard
    basicauth_credentials:
      - username: "${input.DASHBOARD_USERNAME}"
        password: "${secret.DASHBOARD_PASSWORD}"
services:
  - name: auth-v1
    url: http://supabase-auth:9999/
    routes:
      - name: auth-v1
        strip_path: true
        paths: ["/auth/v1"]
  - name: rest-v1
    url: http://supabase-rest:3000/
    routes:
      - name: rest-v1
        strip_path: true
        paths: ["/rest/v1"]
  - name: storage-v1
    url: http://supabase-storage:5000/
    routes:
      - name: storage-v1
        strip_path: true
        paths: ["/storage/v1"]
  - name: meta
    url: http://supabase-meta:8080/
    routes:
      - name: meta
        strip_path: true
        paths: ["/pg"]
    plugins:
      - name: basic-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: true
  - name: studio
    url: http://supabase-studio:3000/
    routes:
      - name: studio
        strip_path: false
        paths: ["/"]
    plugins:
      - name: basic-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: true

notes: Full Supabase stack (Postgres, Auth, REST, Storage, Studio, Kong gateway) served at this app's SlashNode URL. The Studio dashboard and pg-meta are protected by HTTP basic-auth — log in with the dashboard username/password from the install form (auto-generated if left blank). A unique JWT secret and matching anon/service API keys are generated per install (see the app's secrets); the public demo keys are no longer used. API lives under /rest/v1, /auth/v1, /storage/v1.
